{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F01","text":"公司属于通用设备制造业的轴承生产企业，主要从事叉车轴承及回转支承的研发、生产和销售，是全国首批专精特新“小巨人”企业和国家级制造业单项冠军企业。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F02","text":"公司产品可分为叉车门架轴承和回转支承，其中叉车门架轴承市场可进一步分为前装市场和后市场，回转支承目前主要应用于叉车转向系统及AGV/AMR智能搬运车。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0022"]}],"limitations":[]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F03","text":"公司主要产品为叉车轴承（叉车门架滚动轴承）和回转支承；叉车门架滚动轴承具有高负荷、长寿命、轻量化、高可靠性等关键特性，满足国内外叉车行业对门架滚动轴承的需求，实现进口替代。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F04","text":"公司除深耕叉车领域外，积极拓展工业机器人领域客户，已积累海康机器人、三一机器人、库卡机器人、国自机器人、欧米麦克等客户；研发项目覆盖机器人减速器专用精密轴承、轻量化汽车电驱桥专用精密轴承、高温环境专用免维护吊轮轴承、高端重卡变速箱专用精密轴承、智慧物流装备用包胶与尼龙类低噪音滚轮等。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001","source-0013","source-0014","source-0015"]}],"limitations":[]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F05","text":"公司销售模式分为直销模式和贸易商模式；直销模式下游客户为整车厂商，可进一步分为“直接订单销售”和“寄售库存销售”，贸易商模式为买断式销售。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003"]},{"fact_id":"F06","text":"公司主要客户包括安徽合力、杭叉集团、中力股份、中国龙工、丰田叉车、凯傲集团等国内外知名叉车企业，与主要客户签署框架性协议，再以订单形式确定具体产品种类、价格、交付等条款。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003"]},{"fact_id":"F07","text":"公司2025年度营业收入为353,159,911.10元，较上年同期增长2.16%；净利润62,676,195.15元，较上年同期增长8.87%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"353,159,911.10","value":"353159911.10","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业收入同比增长率","raw_value":"2.16","value":"2.16","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年同期"},{"name":"净利润","raw_value":"62,676,195.15","value":"62676195.15","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"净利润同比增长率","raw_value":"8.87","value":"8.87","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年同期"}]}],"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F08","text":"按产品分类，2025年度叉车轴承营业收入309,187,649.61元，营业成本209,651,007.49元，毛利率32.19%，营业收入比上年同期增长0.31%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"叉车轴承营业收入","raw_value":"309,187,649.61","value":"309187649.61","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"叉车轴承营业成本","raw_value":"209,651,007.49","value":"209651007.49","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"叉车轴承毛利率","raw_value":"32.19","value":"32.19","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"叉车轴承营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"0.31","value":"0.31","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"比上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"F09","text":"按产品分类，2025年度回转支承营业收入31,775,179.61元，营业成本16,959,564.92元，毛利率46.63%，营业收入比上年同期增长16.47%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"回转支承营业收入","raw_value":"31,775,179.61","value":"31775179.61","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"回转支承营业成本","raw_value":"16,959,564.92","value":"16959564.92","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"回转支承毛利率","raw_value":"46.63","value":"46.63","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"回转支承营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"16.47","value":"16.47","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"比上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"F10","text":"按产品分类，2025年度其他类营业收入7,083,946.62元，营业成本6,017,390.11元，毛利率15.06%，营业收入比上年同期增长50.54%，主要原因为部分产品配件销售增加。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009","source-0010"],"metrics":[{"name":"其他类营业收入","raw_value":"7,083,946.62","value":"7083946.62","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他类营业成本","raw_value":"6,017,390.11","value":"6017390.11","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他类毛利率","raw_value":"15.06","value":"15.06","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他类营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"50.54","value":"50.54","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"比上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"F11","text":"按产品分类，2025年度材料及下角料营业收入5,113,135.26元，营业成本5,104,090.22元，毛利率0.18%，营业收入比上年同期下降6.77%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"材料及下角料营业收入","raw_value":"5,113,135.26","value":"5113135.26","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"材料及下角料营业成本","raw_value":"5,104,090.22","value":"5104090.22","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"材料及下角料毛利率","raw_value":"0.18","value":"0.18","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"材料及下角料营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-6.77","value":"-6.77","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"比上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"F12","text":"按产品分类合计，2025年度营业收入353,159,911.10元，营业成本237,732,052.74元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"分产品合计营业收入","raw_value":"353,159,911.10","value":"353159911.10","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"分产品合计营业成本","raw_value":"237,732,052.74","value":"237732052.74","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F13","text":"按区域分类，2025年度境内营业收入323,025,298.52元，毛利率31.53%，营业收入比上年同期增长5.06%；境外营业收入30,134,612.58元，毛利率45.08%，营业收入比上年同期下降21.20%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"],"metrics":[{"name":"境内营业收入","raw_value":"323,025,298.52","value":"323025298.52","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"境内毛利率","raw_value":"31.53","value":"31.53","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"境内营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"5.06","value":"5.06","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"比上年同期"},{"name":"境外营业收入","raw_value":"30,134,612.58","value":"30134612.58","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"境外毛利率","raw_value":"45.08","value":"45.08","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"境外营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-21.20","value":"-21.20","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"比上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"F14","text":"2025年度主营业务收入347,811,409.86元，其他业务收入5,348,501.24元；主营业务成本232,603,366.79元，其他业务成本5,128,685.95元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009","source-0025"],"metrics":[{"name":"主营业务收入","raw_value":"347,811,409.86","value":"347811409.86","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务收入","raw_value":"5,348,501.24","value":"5348501.24","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"主营业务成本","raw_value":"232,603,366.79","value":"232603366.79","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务成本","raw_value":"5,128,685.95","value":"5128685.95","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"limitations":[]},"operations_and_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F15","text":"公司采购的原材料主要包括钢材、滚动体、内外圈、保持架等；现有产品所用原材料及配件主要来自国内供应商，物料供应数量充足。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]},{"fact_id":"F16","text":"公司采用备货生产及订单生产结合的生产模式；订单生产根据下游客户订单安排生产，备货生产针对小批量、多规格、交期短的常规需求产品进行适量生产备货。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]},{"fact_id":"F17","text":"报告期内公司主营业务成本中直接材料占比为68.41%，主要原材料为钢材、外圈、内圈、侧滚轮组、滚动体、轴头，上述原材料占直接材料的比例为77.94%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0021"],"metrics":[{"name":"主营业务成本中直接材料占比","raw_value":"68.41","value":"68.41","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"主要原材料占直接材料比例","raw_value":"77.94","value":"77.94","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F18","text":"公司研发模式为根据客户需求、竞争对手动态及市场发展方向确定研发项目，经内部测试通过后交由客户进行台架测试，客户台架测试通过后组织量产；研发项目技术成果归公司所有。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]}],"limitations":[]},"customers_channels_markets":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F19","text":"报告期内公司前五大客户销售金额合计183,583,414.42元，年度销售占比51.97%；其中杭叉集团52,955,665.59元（14.99%）、安徽合力52,690,034.20元（14.92%）、中力股份35,219,700.69元（9.97%）、中国龙工22,680,299.72元（6.42%）、丰田叉车20,037,714.22元（5.67%）。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五大客户销售金额合计","raw_value":"183,583,414.42","value":"183583414.42","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"前五大客户年度销售占比","raw_value":"51.97","value":"51.97","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F20","text":"公司设有销售部和国际贸易部，分别负责境内和境外市场发展方向和产品定位分析、品牌市场推广、新客户开发、客户维护、产品需求分析及订单跟踪。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003"]},{"fact_id":"F21","text":"报告期内公司主营业务收入中外销收入占比为8.53%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0021"],"metrics":[{"name":"主营业务收入中外销收入占比","raw_value":"8.53","value":"8.53","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"limitations":[]},"operating_drivers":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F22","text":"公司主要客户为境内外叉车龙头企业，报告期内前五大客户销售占比51.97%，占比较高，存在客户集中度较高的风险。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0020","source-0021"]},{"fact_id":"F23","text":"公司叉车轴承属于轴承行业中的细分小品类，市场规模较小，且公司份额主要集中于前装市场，规模更大的后市场份额较低；公司通过拓展叉车转向系统、工业机器人、工程机械、石油机械、船舶港口等新兴领域分散单一市场依赖风险。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0022"]},{"fact_id":"F24","text":"公司2025年度研发支出金额10,976,964.05元，占营业收入比例3.11%，研发支出资本化金额为0；研发人员期末67人，占员工总量比例14.14%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0012","source-0013"],"metrics":[{"name":"研发支出金额","raw_value":"10,976,964.05","value":"10976964.05","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"研发支出占营业收入比例","raw_value":"3.11","value":"3.11","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"研发人员占员工总量比例","raw_value":"14.14","value":"14.14","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"limitations":[]},"material_changes":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F25","text":"报告期内公司商业模式未发生重大变化，未对公司的经营情况产生影响；核心竞争力变化情况为不适用；本期重大风险未发生重大变化，报告期内无新增风险因素。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001","source-0003","source-0022","source-0023"]},{"fact_id":"F26","text":"报告期内公司新增授权专利13项，其中发明专利8项，实用新型专利5项；新增软件著作权登记证书1项。截至报告期末共拥有国内外有效专利126项，其中发明专利51项，实用新型专利74项，外观设计1项。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001","source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"期末有效专利数量","raw_value":"126","value":"126","unit":"项","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"期末发明专利数量","raw_value":"51","value":"51","unit":"项","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"limitations":[]}},"supply_chain":{"position":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F27","text":"公司是通用设备制造业的轴承生产企业，主要从事叉车轴承及回转支承的研发、生产和销售，处于轴承制造环节。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]}],"limitations":[]},"upstream_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F28","text":"公司采购的原材料主要包括钢材、滚动体、内外圈、保持架等；主要原材料为钢材、外圈、内圈、侧滚轮组、滚动体、轴头。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002","source-0021"]},{"fact_id":"F29","text":"报告期内前五大供应商采购金额合计82,912,406.40元，年度采购占比60.39%；其中山东冠达轴承科技有限公司34,058,395.32元（24.81%）、东阿广宇精辗轴承有限公司17,576,027.35元（12.80%）、山东钢铁股份有限公司莱芜分公司16,366,526.80元（11.92%）。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五大供应商采购金额合计","raw_value":"82,912,406.40","value":"82912406.40","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"前五大供应商年度采购占比","raw_value":"60.39","value":"60.39","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"limitations":[]},"downstream_customers":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F30","text":"公司产品下游为叉车整车厂商及工业机器人等领域客户；叉车门架轴承用于叉车，回转支承主要应用于叉车转向系统及AGV/AMR智能搬运车。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003","source-0022"]}],"limitations":[]}},"limitations":["未获取公司分产品收入占比的明确百分比披露，仅按营业收入金额列示各产品类别。","未获取叉车轴承前装市场与后市场的具体收入拆分数据。","未获取工业机器人领域客户的具体销售金额或收入占比。"]}
